title: Israeli Drone Strike and Gunfire Kill Two in Jabalia Despite Ceasefire
detail: Israeli forces killed two Palestinians and wounded several others in Jabalia town and refugee camp, northern Gaza Strip, on Wednesday, September 2, 2026. Witnesses said Israeli forces opened fire toward tents housing displaced Palestinians in Jabalia town, while a separate Israeli drone strike hit a gathering of civilians in the Jabalia refugee camp. A medical source at Al-Shifa Hospital confirmed bodies and injured were brought there. The IDF had not commented at the time of reporting. Gaza's Health Ministry separately reported 8 Palestinians killed and 31 wounded strip-wide in the preceding 24 hours, pushing the cumulative death toll since October 7, 2023 to 73,470+ and the ceasefire-period toll to 1,334 killed and 4,429 wounded.

media.caption: Aftermath of Israeli strikes and gunfire in Jabalia, northern Gaza, Sep 2, 2026

title: Katz Says Israel 'Organised and Prepared' to Remove Gaza Population Once Trump Approves
detail: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz said on Wednesday, September 2, 2026 that Israel remains ready to facilitate the emigration of Palestinians from Gaza 'by any means' — 'by sea, by air, by every way possible' — once US President Trump approves the plan and destination countries are identified, though he acknowledged Trump has 'frozen' the initiative under pressure from Arab governments. Katz said, without citing a source, that 80% of Gazans want to leave but Hamas prevents them, and that a green light would come 'when it becomes clear that Hamas is not fulfilling its commitments' under the US plan. Separately, Prime Minister Netanyahu visited an IDF post in Gaza and said Israel will not withdraw from territory it currently controls. Forced displacement of a civilian population in occupied territory is considered a war crime under the Geneva Conventions; Trump's October 2025 ceasefire plan explicitly ruled out forced displacement.

media.caption: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz says Israel is prepared to facilitate Gaza emigration once Trump approves, Sep 2, 2026
